openai-gpt-oss-120b-config.notes: Hidden, FFN, head, vocabulary and layer dimensions are transcribed from the 120B config.

assumption-scaled-gpt-oss.notes: 2240 experts and 1M context are sensitivity assumptions. Public GPT-OSS width, layer count, top-k, alternating attention and mixed precision are retained. NVIDIA did not publish its scaled architecture. Uniform routing without replacement is an unmeasured sensitivity assumption.

assumption-draft.notes: Four public GPT-OSS-120B layers with a 1M context limit are a hypothetical independent drafter. Acceptance must be supplied independently; no model quality claim is made. Uniform routing without replacement is an unmeasured sensitivity assumption.

architecture_assumption.notes: 2240 experts and 1M context are sensitivity assumptions. Public GPT-OSS width, layer count, top-k, alternating attention and mixed precision are retained. NVIDIA did not publish its scaled architecture. Uniform routing without replacement is an unmeasured sensitivity assumption.

limitations: Production whole-model AF DAGs, physical rank ownership, independent serving cohorts and endpoint injection reservations.
Independent model/topology/precision/power assumptions; NVIDIA's undisclosed projection cannot be numerically reproduced.
Native PP and combined expert/tensor groups are validated; unimplemented context-parallel layouts fail configuration.
Warm-up and drain are excluded from steady-state throughput; queue delays and per-resource utilization are exported.
Layer windows and packed expert weights are executed with native per-request routing and KV byte admission.
Warm prefixes are resident; prefix creation, checkpoint loading and model quality are outside the simulation.
Output throughput includes new-suffix prefill, cache handoff and draft service; per-user interactivity excludes TTFT.
Assumed processor TDP plus supplied facility watts; no automatic rack power or cooling estimate.
External draft acceptance uses a seeded Bernoulli prefix; full gamma+1 verification positions and rollback are charged.
Graph host/device costs are explicit analytical assumptions; no measured graph or compiler-vector-overlap calibration is supplied.
